notes.title: 'Hello Puppets!' VR Winter Sale
notes.content:
Happy Holidays Hosts! ❄️🎄

As the jolly season approaches, we've brought you a rather festive news:

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426280/Hello_Puppets/][b]'Hello Puppets!' is 30% Off from December 22 to January 5![/b][/url][/h2]

On behalf of Scout, thank you all for supporting us and sending feedback our way. (Well, let's be honest, Scout will never say this out loud herself. 🙃)

While Scout is not a regular merrymaker, the party that has her definitely spices things up. So why not go on a little adventure with her in the burned down remains of an old children's show studio? Unraveling the long-buried mysteries and hanging out with friends, sounds just like something perfect for this holiday season right?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qSJDx6V.gif[/img]

In the meantime, please don't forget to follow us on Twitter and join our Discord channel, those are great places to bump into Scout. Have a chat with her there, see if she has any upcoming plans for the new year. 👀

[b][url=https://twitter.com/hellopuppets]Twitter[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://discord.gg/UAYP2Gq]Discord[/url][/b]

Enjoy the holidays and see you next year!

Best,
The Puppets Crew

notes.title: Vote for 'Hello Puppets!' at the Steam Awards
notes.content:
Hello Hosts!

Happy early Thanksgiving from the Puppets crew! The Steam Awards of 2020 has started its nomination period and we would appreciate it if you can help nominate us in

[h1][b]The VR Game of The Year Award[/b][/h1].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ovefYXF.png[/img]

If you've enjoyed solving complex, challenging puzzles with Scout or screaming from the pop out scares that lurk around the corners, [b]please cast your vote![/b] We believe we've managed to expand the boundaries of horror and humor in virtual realm, please nominate us if you do too!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UrPEZbr.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1426280/Hello_Puppets/]Nominate Now[/url]

We appreciate your support and will continue to provide better Virtual Reality experiences to you!

Happy Thanksgiving and eat a lot!

Sincerely,
Otherworld Interactive and tinyBuild

notes.title: Hello Puppets! VR Patch 1
notes.content:
Hello hosts!

While Scout took you wandering around the Mortimer's Handeemen studio, we’ve been actively collecting your feedback and reports since the launch. Thank you for sending us the awesome ideas and bug reports, those are very helpful for us to improve on the game and make sure you have a nice journey with Scout. Please do not hesitate to keep sending anything you spot or want to share through our [url=https://twitter.com/hellopuppets]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/UAYP2Gq]Discord[/url].

Now, without further ado, let’s check out the list of patch notes: 

Full Patch Notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Scout pin wasn't attaching properly due to a null ref.
[*] Fixed save bug where Scout pin pieces weren't registering properly and the player could prematurely beat level.
[*] Added a new checkpoint before the stage main room.
[*] Fixed an electrical box save state cosmetic issue.
[*] Implemented priority checks to Scout VO lines in Riley's Lab to ensure players can progress as intended.
[*] Moved keys out of the drawer under Death machine to try to avert bug where players cannot pick up keys.
[*] Pin can no longer be removed from Scout on the Stage to avoid possible bugs with losing pin.
[*] Cosmetic: Rat Paw Prints now spawn earlier.
[*] Implemented new colliders in the Stage and the Sewers that prevent the player from accessing inaccessible areas as both Scout and the Host.
[*] Fixed issue with cranks not resetting on player death.
[*] Quietly updated appearance of a fan favorite and his shadow.
[*] Rebaked lighting for Stage level to hopefully fix lighting issues experienced by some players.
[*] Performance fix in the Sewers level that may have caused some lag.
[*] Adjusted the Rosco chase speed intensity for balance in the Sewers.
[*] Fixed a sequencing issue with the final crank that stopped players from completing the puzzle if they died the first time.
[/list]

Let the ghoul times roll and have an extra spooky time in this immersive horror VR game with touches of comedy, we wish you all a happy Halloween!

Sincerely,
tinyBuild and Otherworld Crew
